description: Green Window is a team from Brazil working where agriculture meets Earth observation. Our name comes from the planting window: the months when a crop fits the local climate, shown in green in our tool. We turn NASA climate and terrain data into clear, explainable guidance that helps growers decide what to plant, when, and what should follow it, protecting their soil and adapting to a changing climate. We build tools that support the farmer's judgment with data they can trust.
